E3, E4, E5, E6, E7, and E8 are about general HEA concepts, density, high-entropy oxides, adhesion of coatings, or corrosion in molten salts, none of which provide specific evidence for the claimed Al2O3 scale formation, growth kinetics, or spallation resistance in the proposed alloy system under the stated conditions.
